Name: gyftin's Birds for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Need more birds? Of course you do! This mod is a re-write (with permission) of gyftin's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15680]Budgie Parrot Kids[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15645]Cockatiel Parrot Kids[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15670]Green Cheek Conure Kids[/url] mods, adding them as stand-alone birds you can keep as livestock! These lil guys can be bought at Marnie's. They live in coops and will produce Mixed Seeds and Sunflower Seeds. 

Enjoy!
